attempt_policy: Prepare exact historical inputs before candidate calls. Commit checker, readiness, candidate and dependencies together before evaluation. One exclusive evaluation claim; retain failed attempts, no retry or output alias.
preservation: Kind/hour/minute/seconds/approved app equality; reason and preview wording are not preserved.
scope: Development validator repair on known fixed mock replies and already captured unit-model outputs, plus a separate24 product-pipeline replay. Passing is eligibility for separate fresh qualification, never phone integration approval.
pipeline: Call recognize(original); only if refused, validate(original, existing captured reply). Record FAST_LOCAL_REQUEST/CHECKED_MODEL/UNKNOWN. Pipeline success is separate from raw model prediction accuracy and checked-model success.
limitations: Known correlated synthetic requests; no fresh, blind or population accuracy claim
The 1582 routes use fixed authored replies; validator acceptance is not a model prediction
The 24 model replies were captured once earlier; this replay performs no inference
Finite routes do not exhaust arbitrary output values or language
No phone, Android action, NPU, Office Kit or promotion evidence
